description: Catalog pointer for PLX company skills. Skill ids are authoritative in the skills repo manifest.json (packages[].skillIds).
notes: petralabx/skills is the canonical company skill content repo; pinSha tracks catalog v1.3.1, which restores seven descriptions that had been corrupted to the literal YAML block-scalar marker '>-' (babysit, canvas, create-hook, create-rule, create-skill, migrate-to-skills, split-to-prs) and corrects manifest gitRef to a commit reachable from main. legacySourceRepo documents the pre-migration source.
